newsitem.title: USA: Marquee Group sets offer for warrants.
newsitem.headline: Marquee Group sets offer for warrants.

text.p: Marquee Group Inc said Thursday it is commencing a tender offer to purchase all of its outstanding redeemable warrants at a price of $2.25 per warrant.
Each warrant entitles the holder to purchase one share of common stock at a price of $7.50 per share, subject to adjustment, until December 4, 2001, unless redeemed earlier.
As of July 22, 1997, there were 4,519,162 warrants issued and outstanding.
The company said it has requested that no director or executive officer of the company tender warrants pursuant to the offer.
Marquee provides integrated event management, television production, marketing, talent representation and consulting services in the sports, news and other entertainment industries.
